security.normal: redaction of keys/values/env; safe path resolution; safe env
security.error: traversal, symlink escape, dangerous commands, bad urls, git arg injection
security.boundary: NUL bytes, empty command, allowlist host

event_bus.error: store failure buffering + flush, subscriber throws

planner_dsl.error: invalid JSON args, unrecognised keyword line

tool_filesystem.boundary: binary files, >1MB files, concurrent atomic writes, delete root refused

tool_terminal_process.error: non-zero exit, crash (SIGSEGV), dangerous command, cwd traversal
tool_terminal_process.boundary: timeout kills tree, 5MB output capped, process limit

tool_http.error: network error retryable, blocked host, bad scheme

runtime_lifecycle.normal: happy path with evidence, explicit steps
runtime_lifecycle.error: failing expectation → FAILURE_ANALYSIS.md, plan unavailable, invalid transitions
runtime_lifecycle.recovery: pause/resume without re-running steps, cancel, retry

self_correction.normal: transient step retried; verification failure → debugger → fix → pass

reviewer.error: secret in content → FAIL, protected path → FAIL
reviewer.boundary: redaction of secret in event log

cli.error: failing task exit code 1, unknown command exit 2

crash_recovery.boundary: no checkpoint, terminal checkpoint, repeated kills
crash_recovery.recovery: completed steps never re-run, control channel pause

stress.normal: 200 tasks concurrency 16, 100 concurrent tool calls, 5000 events x2 stores
stress.boundary: no duplicate events, no leaked checkpoints/processes, bounded heap

chaos.error: store 30% failure, store down, tool crashes/timeouts/invalid output, workdir deleted
